findings.text: the run records status complete while done-when clause 2's -n 8 arm has no result, and its blocker sits under an independent 'blocker:' key rather than the contract's 'blockers:', so a reader of the contract field sees no blocker at all.

the assertion draws before and after from the same constant stub, so it cannot fail when the release drops nothing -- the test name claims a drop the assertion asserts against; stub the count to fall 3 to 0 so the assertion is independent.

the release is keyed on case name, so a second program compiled from an already-built case (test_displaced_flux_loop_is_identified at line 223) is not preceded by a release -- the case that failed with 'Failed to materialize symbols' in the recorded four-case arm.

the fragment's own table peaks at 40,883 mappings against the 65,530 limit it names as the cause, and the no-release pair run was SIGKILLed for memory, so the mapping-limit mechanism is inferred from another node's reading rather than shown by this node's evidence.
